messages:
deploy-bot: Kickoff: staged rollout redwood-inference-api v2.16 -> v2.17, canary=5% global (eu-west + us-east). Release notes: https://internal/release/2.17 :sparkles:
hana: change-window confirmed 21:00-21:30 UTC. tagging infra.
todd: telemetry alert: increased tail latency and a few 504s in eu-west ~+4m into canary. dashboard: https://telemetry/latency?since=15m
marie: I see the 504s correlated with long KV cache fetches on a subset of pods. Could be KV backend flakiness, not model itself.
infra_eu: can we pin eu-west to v2.16 while leaving us-east on 5%? config supports per-region pin.
hana: yes. I'll run a regional pin and lower routing weight for eu-west to 0% of canary.
hana: running: ```
# pin eu-west to previous version and remove canary weight
deployctl rollout region-pin --service redwood-inference-api --region eu-west --version v2.16 --reason "504s/kv-cache latency" --now
deployctl traffic adjust --service redwood-inference-api --region eu-west --canary-weight 0
```
deploy-bot: Action started: region-pin (eu-west) by hana at 1705550032.
ops_shift: apply soft-throttle too: set max_inflight eu-west=40 to drain outstanding requests gracefully.
hana: throttle applied and pin complete. Monitoring...
todd: after pin, eu-west 504s dropped to baseline. us-east remains at 5% with normal metrics.
marie: opening incident for KV backend team. tagging @kv-backend for root-cause.
infra_eu: collect cache client logs and retransmission stats; will attach to incident.
hana: deploy-bot, please pause automated canary advances until incident triage complete.
deploy-bot: Canary auto-advance paused at 1705550055 per request. Current state: global 5% but eu-west pinned to v2.16.
ops_shift: note for audit: rollback command for eu-west region: `deployctl rollback --service redwood-inference-api --version v2.16 --scope region:eu-west`
hana: documented in incident ticket and release notes updated with known-issue entry. scheduling follow-up postmortem for tomorrow 10:00 UTC.
marie: thanks all, will update once KV team posts findings. :white_check_mark:
